access_info_level.description: record: stated in the record. institution: general policy from the per-source mapping file, labelled as such. unknown: not provided.

date_display.description: Date as shown by the source, e.g. 1783, c. 1783-1784, [between 1950 and 1959].

derived_fields.description: Fields whose values were not supplied by the source. Each entry records method (curated, llm_extracted, rule_based), by, and reviewed. A field absent here is assumed to come directly from the source.

field_mapping.description: Path to the per-source mapping file, e.g. mappings/ns_archives.json.

harvested_at.description: Date/time the metadata was retrieved or imported, ISO 8601.

id.description: Stable internal identifier, e.g. bccns-001. Not a source identifier.

original_id.description: Identifier used by the source institution, or the collection name where no identifier is published.

original_terms.description: Catalogue terms as used by the source, retained verbatim for terminology matching. Not used as display labels.

search_terms.description: Query synonyms or terminology expansions. Must not overwrite original terms.

source_id.description: Identifier of the per-source mapping file, e.g. ns_archives.
